sentences.text: The instant appeal has been filed under Section 14A (2) of SC/ ST Act on behalf of the appellant, who is in custody in connection with FIR No.291/2022, Police Station Naya Shahar, District Bikaner for the offences under Sections 376(2)(n), 458, 323, 325 of IPC and Sections 3(2)(V) and 3(2)(Va) of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities Act), 1989 and against the order dated 09.02.2023 passed by learned Special Judge Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Bikaner, whereby the bail application preferred under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant was rejected.

sentences.text: Earlier an appeal was dismissed as withdraw by this Court vide order dated 16.11.2022 with liberty to file afresh after recording the statement of prosecutrix.
It has been submitted by the brother-in-law of the appellant that now the prosecutrix has been examined in the Court as PW/2 and she declared hostile.
The accused-appellant is in judicial custody [2023/RJJD/005910] (2 of 2) [CRLAS-222/2023] and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-appellant.

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.

Heard brother-in-law of the appellant as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.
Having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances as available on record and upon a consideration of the arguments, this Court is of the opinion that the order rejecting the application for bail filed on behalf of the appellant, cannot be sustained and deserves to be set aside.
Consequently, the instant appeal is allowed.
The impugned order dated 09.02.2023 passed by learned Special Judge SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Bikaner is set aside.

entities.text: Special Judge SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Bikaner
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is ordered that the accused-appellant Ramjan Hasan S/o Shri Ahmad Hasan arrested in connection with FIR No.291/2022, Police Station Naya Shahar, District Bikaner shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.2,00,000/- and two sureties bond of Rs.1,00,000/- to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so, subject to the condition that the petitioner will not threaten/intimate the prosecutrix in future and if the petitioner threatens the prosecutrix then the prosecutrix may file an application for cancellation of bail.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The instant appeal has been filed under Section 14A (2) of SC/ ST Act on behalf of the appellant, who is in custody in connection with FIR No.291/2022, Police Station Naya Shahar, District Bikaner for the offences under Sections 376(2)(n), 458, 323, 325 of IPC and Sections 3(2)(V) and 3(2)(Va) of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities Act), 1989 and against the order dated 09.02.2023 passed by learned Special Judge Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Bikaner, whereby the bail application preferred under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant was rejected.
It has been submitted by the brother-in-law of the appellant that now the prosecutrix has been examined in the Court as PW/2 and she declared hostile.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Earlier an appeal was dismissed as withdraw by this Court vide order dated 16.11.2022 with liberty to file afresh after recording the statement of prosecutrix.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-appellant.
Consequently, the instant appeal is allowed.
The impugned order dated 09.02.2023 passed by learned Special Judge SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Bikaner is set aside.
It is ordered that the accused-appellant Ramjan Hasan S/o Shri Ahmad Hasan arrested in connection with FIR No.291/2022, Police Station Naya Shahar, District Bikaner shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.2,00,000/- and two sureties bond of Rs.1,00,000/- to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so, subject to the condition that the petitioner will not threaten/intimate the prosecutrix in future and if the petitioner threatens the prosecutrix then the prosecutrix may file an application for cancellation of bail.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Heard brother-in-law of the appellant as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.
Having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances as available on record and upon a consideration of the arguments, this Court is of the opinion that the order rejecting the application for bail filed on behalf of the appellant, cannot be sustained and deserves to be set aside.
